mapper.select: SELECT sysCodeSequence.id, sysCodeSequence.rule_code, sysCodeSequence.rule_id, sysCodeSequence.period_key, sysCodeSequence.current_max, sysCodeSequence.create_time, sysCodeSequence.update_time FROM sys_code_sequence sysCodeSequence WHERE sysCodeSequence.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND sysCodeSequence.period_key = #{periodKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_code_sequence (id, rule_id, rule_code, period_key, current_max, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{ruleId}, #{ruleCode}, #{periodKey}, #{initialMax}, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (rule_id, period_key) DO NOTHING
